name: vault-skill-factory
description: > Create a reviewable Agent Skill package from mature curated wiki pages, or from one recorded walkthrough of a job (a narrated screen recording, a call, a voice note: "turn this recording into a skill", "I did it once out loud, make it a skill"). Use when turning verified vault knowledge or a recorded workflow into a reusable skill. Reads the vault and writes only to a review directory; it does not install skills.
author: Ar9av
